facts.fact: Konoom Cameroun was licensed as a payment institution (etablissement de paiement) by arrete n°681/MINFI of 21 July 2026, following COBAC decision n°D-2026/092; Orange Money Cameroun and Mobile Money Corporation (MTN) were already licensed, per DGTCFM data of July 2026; the source names no law by title.

Agence Ecofin states that Cameroon's regulatory framework lets payment institutions and also banks and microfinance institutions offer payment services under the conditions the regulation sets; published 2026-09-17, the source gives no date for the framework and names no law by title.
